attempts.summary: Added a regression test to ensure that the TodoForm component correctly shifts focus to the first invalid input when form validation fails. This addresses the gap in error handling behavior following the recent update to the focus-management logic in TodoForm.tsx.

Added a new test case in TodoForm.regression.test.tsx to exercise the description and due-date change handlers, which were previously identified as uncovered source lines. These tests use the real ThemeProvider and component rendering to ensure actual input interaction is captured.
